title: Improved stability of low Fourier modes in inverse problems for potentials
summary: We prove Lipschitz, sub-Hölder and Hölder stability estimates for recovering the low Fourier modes of an unknown potential from the Dirichlet-to-Neumann (DN) map. We study three different cases, depending on the regularity of the difference $q_1-q_2$. First, we consider \[ (-Δ- λ^2 + q)u=0 \quad \text{in} \quad Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^n. \] We show that the difference $q_1-q_2$, assumed to be $M$-bandlimited, can be recovered in a Lipschitz stable way from the difference of the corresponding DN maps.
